recent: DIGISTA 的私募计划获 Bursa Securities 批准延长至 2027 年 2 月 22 日完成。公司近期也发布了季度业绩报告，并有股东权益变动申报。
notable: Bursa Securities 批准公司私募计划延长至 2027 年 2 月 22 日完成。
risks: 公司正在进行最多占已发行股份 30% 的私募计划，可能摊薄现有股东权益。

recent_en: DIGISTA's private placement has been granted an extension by Bursa Securities until 22 February 2027 to complete. The company also released quarterly results and had a change in substantial shareholder interest.

risks_en: The Company is undertaking a private placement of up to 30% of its issued shares, which may dilute existing shareholders.
